scripts.dev: bun scripts/kill-dev-ports.ts && concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "bun run dev:web" "bun run dev:api"
scripts.dev:web: bun scripts/kill-dev-ports.ts --web && dotenv -e .env -- sh -c 'cd packages/web && exec bunx next dev -p "${WEB_PORT:-3000}"'
scripts.dev:api: bun scripts/kill-dev-ports.ts --api && dotenv -e .env -- sh -c 'cd packages/api && exec bun --watch src/index.ts'
scripts.build:web: dotenv -e .env -- sh -c 'cd packages/web && exec bunx next build'
scripts.start: dotenv -e .env -- sh -c 'cd packages/web && exec bunx next start -p "${WEB_PORT:-3000}"'
scripts.check-types: bun --cwd packages/core check-types && bun --cwd packages/api check-types
